items.name: Local AI Memory
items.description: Give your local LLMs persistent long-term memory. A RAG-based proxy that works with LM Studio, Ollama, llama.cpp and any OpenAI-compatible backend. Built with Python, FastAPI, ChromaDB and Next.js.

items.name: gblog — Blogger CLI Skill
items.description: Manage your Google Blogger blog from your AI assistant. Publish, edit, delete and monitor posts through natural language. Available as an OpenClaw skill on ClawhHub.
